operation: Use existing Bun.Archive API for Tauri upstream crate member reads
replacement: Bun.Archive.files with a literal escaped member filter; exact member lookup and UTF-8 text decode

validation.archiveCoverage: tar, gzip, UTF-8 content, bracketed literal filenames, same filename under a different root, missing member and invalid archive

limits: No live upstream download or heavy Cargo build performed.
Network error and unsuccessful HTTP behavior remain with the existing fetch path.
Archive is read in memory; only the requested member is materialized.
No wall-time, native-engine or packed Git-history improvement claimed.
Documentation generation gate not repeated for this scoped implementation change.
